SELECT * FROM D360.L1_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM 
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE D360.L1_CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM (
    AS_OF_DATE	DATE	NOT NULL,
	BANK_ID  VARCHAR(50)    NOT NULL,
	PARAM_TYPE	VARCHAR(50)	NOT NULL,
	PARAM_ID	VARCHAR(50)	NOT NULL,
	PARAM_DESC	VARCHAR(100)	NULL,	
	FROM_VALUE	VARCHAR(100)	NULL,	
	TO_VALUE	VARCHAR(100)	NULL
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'L1_Segment_Param/',
    DATA_SOURCE = D360BSTRG,
    FILE_FORMAT = CSVFormat
);
